One tiny word can put a picture in your head instantly.

Kevin explains it with a simple test: don't think of a cat. The moment you hear the word, an image appears, and you cannot stop it.

Even the phrase "don't think of a cat" makes you think of one, because your mind has to know what not to think about. A single word can place an image in someone's head.

He says this is why the words you choose for yourself matter. Which picture have your own words been painting lately?

A small change in tense can change how you say "I am".

Kevin explains that in the original Hebrew, Moses was told "I will be who I will be", in the future tense. He finds that significant.

So when you say "I am happy, I am successful, I am a winner", you are speaking about who you are becoming, not only who you are today. It is a way of saying the goal before it shows up.

Which "I am" would you want to be true a year from now?
